declarationSets.source: .claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts, which Claude Code 2.1.308 writes beside a plugin that it loads. The copy of 2.1.308 in Claude Desktop 3.6556.2 writes the same file (docs/implementation/desktop-investigation.md).
.claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts, which Claude Code 2.1.310 writes beside a plugin that it loads

.claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts, which Claude Code 2.1.311 writes beside a plugin that it loads. Against 2.1.310, it adds $.prompt.paint, the backgroundColor of a pane, and notes on the tiers of managed hooks. The Mod uses none of them.

.claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts, which Claude Code 2.1.312 writes beside a plugin that it loads. Against 2.1.311, it changes only its version line and the comment on the effort level of a session. The Mod uses neither.

.claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts, which Claude Code 2.1.328 writes beside a plugin that it loads. The Mod type-checks against it. No copy of the 2.1.312 set was available, so no comparison of the two texts exists.

.claude-plugin/types/claude-code/index.d.ts, which Claude Code 2.1.329 writes beside a plugin that it loads. The Mod type-checks against it. Against 2.1.328, it adds the `agent.report` hook and theme types, adds the value `unanswered` to the refusal of a prompt fill, and changes comments. The Mod uses none of these.
